name: libtorrent

reason: README, docs/features.rst, docs/tuning.rst and the RC_2_1 ChangeLog describe efficiency design (single-copy disk buffers, rarest-first piece picker, many 'improve performance' notes) but give no numbers against another BitTorrent implementation or library; web search for comparisons with libtransmission, rtorrent or aria2 found none.
